events.artist: Ghosted (Oren Ambarchi, Johan Berthling, Andreas Werliin) // Arto Lindsay, Skúli Sverrisson, John McCowen
events.subtitle: US premiere of Ghosted, with an opening experimental trio and live visuals
events.factual_description: Roulette presents the US premiere of Ghosted with Oren Ambarchi, Johan Berthling and Andreas Werliin, preceded by a separate Arto Lindsay / Skúli Sverrisson / John McCowen trio on March 15, 2027, at 20:00. Mark Dorf provides live visuals. The primary listing states $30 general advance, $35 general at the door, and $25 qualified student/senior admission.

en.why_it_matters: Ghosted's guitar-electronics, bass and drums meet the volatile improvising sensibilities of an Arto Lindsay trio featuring contrabass clarinet. The documented US premiere, paired bill and Mark Dorf's visuals create a specific cross-genre night—not merely a familiar touring band.
en.trip_verdict: Actively consider building a Brooklyn evening around this A+ double bill. The US-premiere billing makes it notable, but does not prove that the musicians will never play this program again.

es.why_it_matters: El estreno estadounidense de Ghosted une la guitarra y electrónica de Oren Ambarchi con Johan Berthling y Andreas Werliin; antes, Arto Lindsay, Skúli Sverrisson y John McCowen llevan la improvisación hacia otro terreno. Las visuales de Mark Dorf completan una noche de cruces muy particular.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio a esta doble función si se arma una visita a Brooklyn. Es A+ por la combinación concreta y el estreno en Estados Unidos, sin afirmar que será irrepetible.

events.subtitle: Premiere of Pioneers for Linda Manzer-built guitars
events.factual_description: Roulette announces Joel Harrison Guitar Choir on March 16, 2027 at 20:00. The evening includes the premiere of Pioneers, commissioned by the Archtop Foundation for baritone, soprano and 12-string instruments by luthier Linda Manzer, as well as newly composed electric guitar music. The presenter lists five guitarists, although it calls the project a roving quartet; exact personnel per piece are not specified. General prices are $25 advance and $30 door.

en.why_it_matters: The draw is the music being built for particular instruments: a new Archtop Foundation commission for Linda Manzer's baritone, soprano and 12-string guitars, within Harrison's collective guitar language. Nels Cline, Gilad Hekselman and the other named guitarists make this more than a virtuoso showcase.
en.trip_verdict: Make active room for this A+ Roulette program if already planning New York; the premiere and commissioned instruments distinguish it. The announcement does not establish an unrepeatable gathering warranting S.

es.why_it_matters: La noticia no es sólo reunir guitarristas brillantes: Joel Harrison estrena Pioneers, un encargo concebido para guitarras barítona, soprano y de doce cuerdas construidas por Linda Manzer. La presencia de Nels Cline, Gilad Hekselman y los demás músicos promete explorar la guitarra como ensamble, no como desfile de solos.
es.trip_verdict: Lo priorizaría dentro de un viaje a Nueva York. El estreno y los instrumentos diseñados para la obra justifican A+, sin atribuirle una exclusividad irrepetible.

events.subtitle: Solo electronic improvisation and spatialized microsound with Brian O'Reilly visuals
lineup: Earl Howard — solo performer, electronics and improvisation
Brian O'Reilly — visualizations for Curtis Roads's set
events.factual_description: Roulette schedules separate performances by Earl Howard and Curtis Roads on March 30, 2027 at 20:00. Howard is billed for a solo performance. Roads will present a new spatialized electronic work exploring microsound and tape-echo feedback, with video by his longtime collaborator Brian O'Reilly. General admission $25 advance and $30 doors.

en.why_it_matters: Two long-running experimenters approach electronic sound from different sides: Earl Howard's live improvising practice and Curtis Roads's spatialized microsound with Brian O'Reilly's images. Roads helped establish computer granular synthesis; hearing the current work in a performance space gives the technical history an audible present.
en.trip_verdict: Actively prioritize if electronic composition and spatial sound are the point of a New York visit. A+ reflects the living-master encounter; the presenter does not establish that this is their last or only appearance.

es.why_it_matters: Earl Howard lleva décadas convirtiendo la electrónica en improvisación en vivo; Curtis Roads trabaja ahora el microsonido espacializado, el eco de cinta y la imagen con Brian O'Reilly. Escuchar a dos pioneros en un mismo programa permite oír cómo sigue evolucionando esa historia técnica y musical.
es.trip_verdict: Si el interés es la electrónica experimental, esta noche merece hacerse un hueco importante en Nueva York. A+ por los maestros y el dispositivo sonoro; no hay pruebas de despedida ni de una única presentación.
